_comment: Awareness image-reply lane (owner direction 2026-10-01): subs scanned for threads where a picture of the site, with no link, invites 'what is that?!'. Read by awareness-scan.mjs, which runs every ~20 minutes with feedRequestsPerRun anonymous RSS requests and rotates through every sub (hot and new) and search query, least recently fetched first (awareness-rotation.mjs). imageComments is a human override ('image' | 'text_only' | null = ask about.json at run time); when about.json is unreachable the lane marks the sub 'unknown', never 'text_only'. A sub with verified:false was named from memory and could not be confirmed live from the build environment (reddit.com blocks it, 2026-10-01); a 404/empty feed degrades to a logged skip, never a failure.

excluded.name: SwiftlyNSFW
excluded.why: NSFW (over18). Owner direction names it as excluded; about.json over18 is also checked at run time.

excluded.name: YouBelongWithMemes
excluded.why: Meme-only culture: an unprompted site screenshot under a meme reads as an ad, and threads rarely match a discussion type.

excluded.name: TaylorSwiftMerch
excluded.why: Trading/merch sub, not a discussion fit.

excluded.name: TaylorSwiftLyrics
excluded.why: Lyric threads only; guardrail 2 keeps lyrics off our cards and replies.

subs.name: TaylorSwift
subs.selfPromoNote: No self-promo; a link is a ban risk (docs/community/watchlist.md). Image-only reply with no link and no site name in the text.
subs.notes: Main hub (~3.8M). Highest volume; era rankings, anniversaries, news reactions. Megathreads are buried, skip them.

subs.name: swifties
subs.selfPromoNote: Assume standard Reddit 9:1 norm; no link, no pitch.
subs.notes: Fan hub, chattier than r/TaylorSwift; good for nostalgia and 'which era' threads.

subs.name: SwiftlyNeutral
subs.selfPromoNote: Self-promo is only allowed inside the pinned Daily Discussion thread (watchlist.md). Image reply on a normal post must stay link-free and read as a fan sharing something.
subs.notes: Larger, more opinionated crowd; skip pile-ons and anything personal-life. Era debates and news reactions fit.

subs.name: TaylorSwiftTheories
subs.selfPromoNote: No rule text found; treat as no-promo. Replying with a card for the exact moment being theorised is on-topic.
subs.notes: Easter-egg and theory threads, low volume. Best fit for a moment-specific card.

subs.name: popheads
subs.selfPromoNote: Strict self-promo rules; only Taylor-specific threads, and never a pitch.
subs.notes: General pop sub. Only threads that name Taylor/an era/an album; everything else is off-topic.

subs.name: TaylorSwiftPictures
subs.selfPromoNote: Photo sub; keep replies to the discussion, no promotion.
subs.notes: Photo-first; few titles match a discussion type, so expect a trickle (anniversary and 'which era' photo posts).

subs.name: TaylorSwiftBookClub
subs.selfPromoNote: Follow Reddit self-promo guidelines (watchlist.md rule 5). Low traffic.
subs.notes: Small; only worth it for timeline and Easter-egg threads.

subs.name: ErasTour
subs.notes: Eras Tour memories and nostalgia threads. Named from memory; confirm it is active before relying on it.

queries: "taylor swift" (era OR album OR theory OR anniversary)
swifties OR "eras tour" OR "life of a showgirl"
search._comment: Reddit-wide search RSS (search.rss?q=...&sort=new&t=day) finds Taylor threads outside the fan subs: r/popculturechat, r/AskReddit, r/Music and so on. Results use the strict Taylor-name filter, the same thread filters and caps; unknown subs are image-unverified. blockSubs are never touched (gossip/hostile); NSFW names are always blocked.
